title: Processor contract minimum terms
obligation_text: Processor agreements must define the subject matter, duration, nature and purpose of processing, data types, data subject categories, documented instructions, confidentiality, security, subprocessor controls, assistance, return or deletion, audit rights, and breach support obligations.

title: Sufficient guarantees from processors
obligation_text: Acme may use only processors that provide sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organizational measures for GDPR-compliant processing.

title: Restricted transfer safeguards
obligation_text: Transfers of personal data outside the EEA must rely on a valid transfer mechanism and provide essentially equivalent protection in practice.

title: Transparency about recipients
obligation_text: Privacy notices must explain relevant recipient categories and any third-country transfer circumstances that matter to individuals.

title: Data minimization and storage limitation
obligation_text: Only data necessary for the stated purpose may be disclosed to vendors and it must not be retained longer than needed.

title: Records of processing accuracy
obligation_text: Records of processing and transfer context must remain accurate when a new vendor or disclosure arrangement is onboarded, renewed, or materially changed.

title: Security of processing
obligation_text: Controllers and processors must implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures proportional to the risk posed by the processing.
